onnxruntime-web — WebAssembly build
===================================

Files
- ort.min.mjs                       48 KB  (npm: dist/ort.wasm.min.mjs)
- ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs        24 KB  (wasm loader glue)
- ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm     10.6 MB  (SIMD, single-thread)

Source: npm package onnxruntime-web@1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4
        (https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime, js/web)
License: MIT — Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
         https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/main/LICENSE

Naming
- `ort.min.mjs` here is the **wasm-only** bundle (upstream `ort.wasm.min.mjs`),
  vendored under the file name that sw.js SHELL and js/stt-worker.js use.
  It is not the "all" bundle: no WebGL/WebGPU/WebNN execution providers.
- The wasm-only loader requests `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs` (not the `.jsep`
  variant), which is why those two files, and not the 20.6 MB jsep pair, ship here.
  Using the "all" bundle would force the 20.6 MB jsep binary and add ~10 MB.

Why vendored
- CSP `connect-src 'self'`: no CDN at runtime.
- numThreads is pinned to 1 in js/stt-worker.js, so no SharedArrayBuffer and no
  COOP/COEP headers are needed on the static host.

Updating
- Replace all three files from one npm version and re-run
  `node tools/stt-test.mjs` and `node tools/check.mjs`. Never mix versions.
